description: 说清故障、已做的排查、错误代码，要求远程协助和工单号，不被客服话术绕晕。

targetChunks.en: I'm having trouble connecting to the internet.
targetChunks.note: have trouble doing = 做某事有困难；比 I can't 更具体。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'm having trouble connecting to the internet.

targetChunks.note: keeps + doing = 反复发生；描述间歇性故障。
targetChunks.exampleEn: It keeps disconnecting every few minutes.

targetChunks.note: already 表明你做过基础排查，节省时间。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I've already tried restarting it twice.

targetChunks.en: Can you walk me through the setup?
targetChunks.zh: 你能带我过一遍设置吗？
targetChunks.note: walk someone through = 一步步指导；技术支持核心句。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Can you walk me through the setup?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 你能带我过一遍设置吗？

targetChunks.en: Could you remote in and take a look?
targetChunks.note: remote in = 远程连接；比 access my computer 专业。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Could you remote in and take a look?

targetChunks.note: 客服常问；自己报案时也可以先准备好。
targetChunks.exampleEn: What's the error message on your screen?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 屏幕上是什么错误提示？

targetChunks.note: error code = 错误代码；报数字/字母串。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'm getting an error code — four zero four.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我这边有个错误代码，四零四。

targetChunks.note: known issue = 官方已知故障；问清是否普遍问题。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Is there a known issue with the app today?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 今天 App 有已知问题吗？

targetChunks.note: 问修复时间；比 When will it work 更直接。

targetChunks.en: Could you send me a ticket number?
targetChunks.note: ticket number = 工单号；后续跟进必备。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Could you send me a ticket number?

targetChunks.en: I'll try that and call you back.
targetChunks.note: 结束通话的标准说法；比 I'll try then return 自然。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'll try that and call you back.

roleplay.promptZh: 家里的网络反复断线。你打技术支持电话：说明故障、已做的排查、错误代码，要求远程协助并拿工单号。
roleplay.promptEn: Your internet keeps dropping. Call tech support: describe the issue, what you've tried, the error code, ask for remote help, and get a ticket number.
goals: 说清故障频率和已做排查
提供错误代码并要求远程
拿到工单号和修复时间

script.speaker: other
script.en: What seems to be the problem?

script.speaker: you
script.en: I'm having trouble connecting to the internet. It keeps disconnecting.
script.zh: 我连不上网，而且老是断。

script.speaker: you
script.en: I've already tried restarting it twice. I'm getting an error code.
script.zh: 我已经重启两次了。我这边有个错误代码。

script.speaker: you
script.en: It says four zero four. Is there a known issue?
script.zh: 显示四零四。有已知问题吗？

script.speaker: other
script.en: Not that I know of. Let me check.
script.zh: 据我所知没有。我查一下。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Could you remote in and take a look? Can you walk me through the setup?
script.zh: 你能远程看一下吗？能带我过一遍设置吗？

script.speaker: you
script.en: How long until it's fixed? Could you send me a ticket number?
script.zh: 多久能修好？能给我工单号吗？

script.speaker: other
script.en: I'll email you a ticket now.

script.speaker: you
script.en: Thanks. I'll try that and call you back.
script.zh: 谢谢。我试一下再打回来。
